title: Residual-Based Adaptive Refinement in Hybrid Variational-Collocation PINNs for Singular Elliptic PDEs with Mixed Dirichlet-Neumann Boundary Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.26458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Solutions of second-order elliptic PDE problems on nonconvex or cracked domains with mixed Dirichlet-Neumann conditions typically lie outside $H^2(\Omega)$. Near re-entrant corners, crack tips and points where the boundary condition changes type, the gradient grows like $r^{\lambda-1}$ with $\lambda<1$. We study residual-based adaptive refinement in hybrid variational-collocation PINNs. A multiscale Fourier-feature network is trained on a composite loss. The loss combines a variational residual tested against Legendre bubble functions, a strong-form collocation term and penalties for the Dirichlet and Neumann data. The variational term needs only first derivatives of the network, whereas the collocation term requires second derivatives and provides a residual that can be evaluated at any point. translated_title: 针对具有混合狄利克雷-诺伊曼边界条件的奇异椭圆偏微分方程的混合变分-配置物理信息神经网络中基于残差的自适应细化方法
translated_abstract: 对于在非凸或含裂纹区域上、具有混合狄利克雷-诺伊曼边界条件的二阶椭圆偏微分方程问题，其解通常不属于 $H^2(\Omega)$ 空间。在凹角、裂纹尖端以及边界条件类型发生改变的点附近，梯度以 $r^{\lambda-1}$ 的形式增长，其中 $\lambda<1$。我们研究了混合变分-配置物理信息神经网络（PINNs）中基于残差的自适应细化方法。该方法采用多尺度傅里叶特征网络，在复合损失函数上进行训练。该损失函数结合了三项：用勒让德气泡函数检验的变分残差、强形式配置项以及对狄利克雷和诺伊曼边界数据的惩罚项。变分项仅需网络的一阶导数，而配置项需要二阶导数，并提供了一个可在任意点评估的残差。在每个训练阶段结束后，由该残差筛选出的候选点被添加到配置点集中。该方法在五个二维……（原文截断）上进行了测试。
tldr: 提出一种混合变分-配置物理信息神经网络框架，通过基于残差的自适应配置点细化策略，有效捕捉混合狄利克雷-诺伊曼边界条件下椭圆偏微分方程在凹角和裂纹尖端附近的解奇异性。
en_tdlr: A hybrid variational-collocation PINN framework is proposed, which uses residual-based adaptive refinement of collocation points to effectively capture solution singularities of elliptic PDEs with mixed Dirichlet-Neumann boundary conditions near re-entrant corners and crack tips.
